LESSON: JESUS’ PASSION, DEATH AND RESURRECTION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.6: Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection, part of The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ in Grade 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: which lessons did they learn from the betrayal ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Jesus’ Passion, Death and Resurrection together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy Skills: learners access, find, and manage online information on the arrest and burial of Jesus Christ.

● Communication and Collaboration: learners enhance their skills in communication and team building as they discuss in

groups the significance of Christ’s passion death and resurrection.

Values:
● Respect: learners discuss and accommodate diverse opinions.

● Responsibility: learners engage in assigned roles and tasks such as role-play or dramatization.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Coping with Emotions: learners discuss the arrest, betrayal, and passion of Jesus Christ, and how it applies in their lives.

● Spiritual Development: learners discuss the significance of Christ’s resurrection to Christians today.

Link to other Subjects:

• Social Studies: learners exhibit self-management skills as they share experiences on coping with emotions and stress such as

betrayal by close family members or friends.

• Pre-technical Studies: learners download and watch video clips on the events that took place at Mount Olives.
